pages.title: Maledictus
pages.text: First, these opponents must be defeated in this world: Skor, Frostbitten Golem, Yeti. Take part in the first victory over Maledictus or remain near the encounter. A rematch does not award a new advancement.
This reusable locator marks the encounter and opens the map. Look for it among cartographer and wandering-trader offers; it does not replace the encounter’s own awakening method.
